narrative.overview: This local preview inherits the existing OHMI Operate interface. A compact React control area surrounds the native designElectronics canvas; it does not introduce a new visual identity. This file records M1–M4 local implementation, including the explicit Ask OHMI build disclosure, workspace handoff and on-demand DOM circuit tools. The application-wide authority remains web-app/DESIGN.md, with product constraints in web-app/PRODUCT.md and phase boundaries in ../PLAN.md.
keyCharacteristics: Light mode by default; mint actions on pale study surfaces and neutral charcoal in dark mode.
Familiar labeled controls, restrained borders and the unchanged canonical OHMI mascot in the shared shell.
Native technical canvas retained; no new illustrations, mascot variants or decorative motion.

rules.name: The Technical Canvas Rule
rules.body: Theme the surrounding controls without recoloring physical part markings or making schematic symbols unreadable.

rules.name: The Captured Work Rule
rules.body: Saving records an explicit captured snapshot, not continuous autosave; later edits need another save. Keep .dez download available, and require it when private storage is unavailable. File replacement, reload and workspace exit require confirmation; canceling navigation retains the runtime and circuit.

rules.name: The Account and Document Rule
rules.body: Account changes clear private project state and the engine runtime. A captured native replacement generation plus UID binds the current private record/revision; replacing a native document creates a separate project even if its UID matches. Ordinary edits can update the same record. This session identity prevents accidental overwrite; it is not an authentication credential. Server authorization remains separate.

rules.name: The Explicit Draft Rule
rules.body: Building is a distinct action, never an automatic interpretation of chat text. Keep generation, stopping the wait, checking the same request and opening a new editable draft visibly separate. Do not imply that stopping the wait cancels server work or that a completed model answer has already opened or saved a circuit.

rules.name: The Shared Engine Rule
rules.body: DOM tools and canvas controls edit the same native document and undo history. Presentation changes must not replace the iframe or reset student work.

rules.name: The Canvas Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus canvas changes only presentation and scroll. Keep a visible return action and simulation state, restore keyboard focus, and retain every action in the ordinary layout.

dos: Do reuse the existing semantic tokens, shared Button and exact approved mascot.
Do preserve the native technical rendering and disclose simulation limits.
Do distinguish local-preview verification from production readiness.
Do keep DOM tools, native history and focused-canvas presentation on the same runtime.
Do guard unapplied inspector changes and restore focus when leaving a temporary editing surface.
Do preserve planner caveats and distinguish model narrative, captured simulation evidence and actual saved work.
donts: Don't infer full canvas accessibility from the surrounding DOM controls.
Don't treat local heading exceptions, upstream canvas geometry or incidental test toasts as new application-wide design rules.
Don't add replacement mascot art, unapproved visual-analysis controls or unverified hosted-save/live-inference claims to this preview.
